description: This file defines the WebDriverHelper class within the Helper namespace. It provides methods to retrieve configuration and environment variables related to the WebDriver, including database credentials, URLs, and third-party service credentials. It acts as a utility/helper class to facilitate test automation setup within a SuiteCRM testing framework.

classes.name: WebDriverHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing methods to access configuration values and environment variables for WebDriver-based tests within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration object for WebDriver.

methods.name: getInstanceURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the test instance, checking environment variable 'INSTANCE_URL' or configuration, defaulting to 'http://localhost/'.

methods.name: getDatabaseDriver
methods.description: Returns the database driver type, checking environment variable 'DATABASE_DRIVER' or configuration, defaulting to MYSQL.

methods.name: getDatabaseName
methods.description: Returns the database name, checking environment variable 'DATABASE_NAME' or configuration, defaulting to 'automated_tests'.

methods.name: getDatabaseHost
methods.description: Returns the database host, checking environment variable 'DATABASE_HOST' or configuration, defaulting to 'localhost'.

methods.name: getDatabaseUser
methods.description: Returns the database user, checking environment variable 'DATABASE_USER' or configuration, defaulting to 'automated_tests'.

methods.name: getDatabasePassword
methods.description: Returns the database password, checking environment variable 'DATABASE_PASSWORD' or configuration, defaulting to 'automated_tests'.

methods.name: getAdminUser
methods.description: Returns the admin user, checking environment variable 'INSTANCE_ADMIN_USER' or configuration, defaulting to 'admin'.

methods.name: getAdminPassword
methods.description: Returns the admin password, checking environment variable 'INSTANCE_ADMIN_PASSWORD' or configuration, defaulting to 'admin'.

methods.name: getElasticSearchHost
methods.description: Returns the Elasticsearch host, checking environment variable or configuration, defaulting to 'localhost'.

methods.name: getBrowserStackUsername
methods.description: Returns the BrowserStack username, checking environment variable or configuration.

methods.name: getBrowserStackAccessKey
methods.description: Returns the BrowserStack access key, checking environment variable or configuration.

methods.name: getBrowserStackLocalFolderURL
methods.description: Returns the BrowserStack local folder URL, checking environment variable or configuration.
